details: The worst-case online mistake bound dominates VC dimension.
name: Worst Mistakes / VC Dimension
proof: Let $S$ be a shattered set of size $d$.  Even when the learner knows the whole presentation order, an adversary may present the points of $S$ one at a time and assign at each point the label opposite to the learner's prediction.  After all $d$ rounds, shattering supplies a concept realizing the resulting labeling, so this is a valid target-consistent run with $d$ mistakes.  Hence $\mathrm M_{\mathrm{worst}}\geq\mathrm{VC}$.
